analysis.rationale: Standalone PAT grew 14% YoY to ₹185.5 Cr, operating EBITDA margin improved to 13.9%, and dividend increased to ₹7.50 per share. The company is debt-free with ₹877 Cr cash, indicating strong financial health.
analysis.summary: TTK Prestige reported standalone net profit of ₹185.5 Cr (up 14% YoY) and recommended a dividend of ₹7.50 per share for FY2025-26.
